recipes.title: Autonomous Local Voice Agent
recipes.tagline: Speak to a fully offline assistant: transcribe locally, reason with a local LLM, and answer with synthetic speech — zero cloud calls, zero token fees.
recipes.why_it_works: whisper.cpp and llama.cpp are both dependency-light C++ runtimes that saturate CPU SIMD units; ChatTTS closes the loop with natural prosody. Nothing leaves the machine, so latency stays sub-second and privacy is absolute.
recipes.tradeoffs: CPU-only speech synthesis caps concurrency; expect ~real-time TTS on 8+ cores. A GPU shifts every stage into high throughput.

recipes.title: Enterprise Private RAG
recipes.tagline: A production-grade retrieval pipeline over confidential documents: embedded vector storage, high-throughput inference, cross-encoder reranking, and a polished chat UI.
recipes.why_it_works: LanceDB embeds beside your app with zero servers; vLLM's PagedAttention keeps GPU memory fragmentation flat under concurrent queries; BGE reranking lifts retrieval precision exactly where enterprise docs are ambiguous.
recipes.tradeoffs: vLLM wants a CUDA/ROCm GPU for its sweet spot; rerankers add 100-300ms per query — cache aggressively.

recipes.title: Autonomous Code Refactor Swarm
recipes.tagline: An AI engineering loop that edits real repositories: AST-aware coding agent, local code-tuned model, and ephemeral sandboxes that keep experiments disposable.
recipes.why_it_works: Aider's repo-map keeps the LLM grounded in the real AST; DeepSeek-Coder-class models run offline on Ollama; Docker sandboxes make every speculative edit reversible, so the swarm can iterate without fear.
recipes.tradeoffs: Non-deterministic diffs demand a strict test gate before auto-merge; large repos need chunked repo-maps to fit context windows.

recipes.title: On-Device Edge Vision Pipeline
recipes.tagline: Ship a neural camera that classifies and tracks objects on a $30 board or a phone, fully offline.
recipes.why_it_works: INT8 post-training quantization shrinks vision models 4x with <1% accuracy loss; NCNN/MNN run kernel-fused graphs on ARM NEON without a heavyweight framework; FiftyOne closes the data loop.
recipes.tradeoffs: Quantization-aware training is needed for accuracy-critical classes; NPU offload varies by vendor SDK.

recipes.title: Domain Fine-Tuning Foundry
recipes.tagline: Turn a general open-weights model into a domain expert: efficient LoRA adapters, distributed training backbone, and alignment pass.
recipes.why_it_works: Unsloth fuses LoRA kernels for 2x throughput; DeepSpeed ZeRO shards optimizer state across GPUs; TRL's DPO gives alignment without the PPO instability tax.
recipes.tradeoffs: LoRA adapters trade some ceiling quality for 10-100x cheaper training; full pre-training stays out of reach without a cluster.

recipes.title: Agentic Observability Lab
recipes.tagline: Instrument, evaluate, and guardrail your agent fleet: traces for every tool call, regression evals before every deploy.
recipes.why_it_works: LangGraph's explicit state machine makes every hop traceable; Langfuse stores traces cheaply and self-hosts; eval harnesses turn prompt regressions into red builds before users notice.
recipes.tradeoffs: Trace storage grows with agent verbosity — sample high-volume spans; guardrail filters add ~50ms per call.
